title: uninstalling a symlinked widget removes the destination, not the symlink
line: Uninstalling a widget that is a symlink now removes only the link and leaves the folder it points to untouched.
explanation: KPackage::PackageJob::uninstall sets the package path, and Package::setPath stores the canonical path with symlinks resolved. The uninstall thread then ran QDir::removeRecursively on that path, so for a symlinked widget it deleted the real source folder and left a dangling link. The change passes the unresolved path to the job and, when it is a symlink, removes just the link with QFile::remove.

commits.message:
PackageJob: Don't delete the target of a symlinked package on uninstall

Uninstalling a widget that is a symlink deleted the folder the link points
to, because the package path has symlinks resolved. Now the unresolved path
is passed on and only the link is removed, also when updating over a link.

BUG: 508717

media.caption: Master: after uninstalling the symlinked My Dev Widget, its source folder ~/src/my.widget is gone and the dangling link stays
Fixed: the link is removed, ~/src/my.widget and its files are intact
